mechanism: Phenelzine is an MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase, potentially increasing serotonergic and noradrenergic effects of melatonin while melatonin may have modest serotonergic activity, creating additive CNS effects.
action: Monitor for serotonergic symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia); melatonin is generally considered safer than other serotonergic agents with MAOIs, but caution and dose adjustment may be warranted.
